development_works.Brief Descriptions: Boundary Wall in brick masonary with common burnt clay F.P.S. (non-modular) bricks of class designation 75 in cement mortar (1;6) on RCC footing and column structure.
Laying of roads with proper longitudinal and cross-sectional road slopes as per design.
Laying of Pavers of Tiles over well compacted subgrade with GSB layers.

development_works.Development Work Name: Water Supply Including Drinking Water Facilities
development_works.Brief Descriptions: system comprising of sand filter and activated carbon filter along with softener. The water distribution (fresh and recycled water) by means of pumped mains laid suspended to basement ceiling. A separate network of pipes laid for soft landscape areas with seperate pumps which would draw water from treated effluent of STP. A supply of building tanks will be done by set of pumps.

Soil  waste from toilets  kitchen will be collected in single network of sewer pipes laid underground having manholes /inspection chambers at appropriate intervals. Manholes will be provided for all depths starting from 900mm with Pre-cast cement concrete /SFRC covers medium duty type with frame.

The terrace and balconies of the building to be drained by means of down take pipes while open areas and roads would be drained into drains which are aligned along the roads within the complex as per Landscape designs.
Landscaping of the parks with plantation including trees, shrubs and ground covers and recreational areas with Swimming Pool, sports facilities and walkways.
Habitable Shading Local trees/Fruit trees throughout the project in parks and on roadside as per landscape drawings.

development_works.Development Work Name: Design For Electric Supply Including Street Lighting
development_works.Brief Descriptions: The power shall be made available and metered by UPPCL separately for common services and at a multipoint for consumers wherein meterboards shall be placed at respective floors in each tower along with the rising mains. Provision of DG backup shall be made and metered by prepaid meter. Separate HT metering rooms for individual and common.
The Club house shall be provided with Gymnasium and fitness centre, Gaming  zone, Banquet Hall.

development_works.Development Work Name: Treatment and Disposal System of Sewage and Sullage water
development_works.Brief Descriptions: Provision of sewage treatment plant is proposed to treat waste water generated. Recycle of treated effluent will reduce the total net fresh water demand of project. Thereby reducing the load on ground water sources and dependency on municipal supply.

development_works.Development Work Name: Solid Waste Management And Disposal System
development_works.Brief Descriptions: Segregation of dry and wet garbage with separate dustbins.

Rain water harvesting and ground water recharging for roof and non-roof areas is provided. The total volumetric capacity of recharge structures shall be as per regulation norms. Providing Latest Irrigation systems such as per drip irrigation/sprinkler system to reduce water consumption in horticulture.

development_works.Development Work Name: Energy Management System Including Use of Renewable Energy
development_works.Brief Descriptions: Provision of Solar panels to reduce the electrical load of common areas.

development_works.Development Work Name: Fire Protection And Fire Safety System
development_works.Brief Descriptions: Fire tender path shall be provided as per NBC. Fire fighting systems along with pumps and water storage tanks shall be provided as per NBC norms.

development_works.Development Work Name: Social Infrastructure And Other Public Amenities Including Public Health Services
development_works.Brief Descriptions: Kids Play areas, Outdoor Gym. Swimming Pool and Walkways.
Staircases shall be provided In Basement  all the Towers for fire/ emergency exit as per norms.
